subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Respeitar os turnos de fala, na participação em conversações e em discussões ou atividades coletivas, na sala de aula e na escola e formular perguntas coerentes e adequadas em momentos oportunos em situações de aulas, apresentação oral, seminário etc.

components.description_pt: Seguir regras acordadas para turnos em discussões em grupo
components.description_en: Follow agreed-upon rules for taking turns during group discussions
components.cc_component_description: Follow agreed-upon rules for taking turns during group discussions

components.description_pt: Formular questões coerentes em momentos apropriados em apresentações orais ou seminários
components.description_en: Formulate coherent questions at appropriate moments in oral presentations or seminars
components.cc_component_description: Identify moments in a discussion when clarification or elaboration is needed and respond appropriately

components.description_pt: Formular questões específicas que avancem uma discussão colaborativa
components.description_en: Pose specific questions that advance a collaborative discussion
components.cc_component_description: Pose specific questions that advance a collaborative discussion

cc_matches.description: Follow agreed-upon rules for discussions (e.g., listening to others and taking turns speaking about the topics and texts under discussion).
Pose and respond to specific questions by making comments that contribute to the discussion and elaborate on the remarks of others.
Ask for clarification and further explanation as needed about the topics and texts under discussion.
